name: Muha Meds | 1g 510 Cartridge | Green Crack
description: Green Crack is highly recommended and has nothing to do with the epidemic that happened in Los Angeles during the 80’s. This potent strain’s origins are a mystery, combining Skunk #1 with an unknown counterpart. Green Crack is an amazing sativa that has an appetizing tropical tang followed by a kushy exhale.
